classes.flagship_research: Primary research repository intended for external technical or mathematical review. Internal verification does not imply peer review or world novelty.
classes.flagship_research_engineering: Primary experimental engineering repository with evidence-bearing measurements in a stated tested scope.
classes.flagship_engineering: Primary engineering repository intended for technical review; not presented as a scientific breakthrough by classification alone.
classes.creative_technology: Original creative/interactive technology separated from scientific evidence claims.
classes.engineering_prototype: Original implementation prototype; capability and production claims are limited to explicitly documented tests.
classes.interaction_prototype: Human-computer interaction prototype; clinical, regulatory or performance claims require separate evidence.
classes.interface_simulation_prototype: Interface/simulation work that does not imply operational deployment or real-world authority.
classes.creative_embedded_game: Embedded game/creative firmware; game terminology is not a scientific AI claim.
classes.exploratory_hypothesis_tool: Software for generating/ranking hypotheses; output is not experimental validation.
classes.creative_social_protocol: Voluntary creative/social protocol; not scientific evidence or authority over AI systems, people or funds.
classes.archival_meta_registry: Archive of historical hypotheses, records, metaphors and corrections; object presence is not endorsement or validation.
classes.legacy_experimental_sandbox: Historical experimental code retained for lineage; not a current flagship evidence source.
classes.legacy_integration_snapshot: Historical integration state superseded by newer public entry points.
classes.supporting_interface_prototype: Supporting UI/tooling repository with no independent scientific authority.
classes.creative_application: Creative/entertainment application; symbolic or narrative output is not predictive or professional authority.
classes.legacy_health_information_prototype: Historical health-information software; not a diagnostic, treatment or emergency-triage system.
classes.legacy_application: Historical application/game repository; not part of the evidence-bearing research portfolio.
classes.upstream_derived_working_copy: Repository based on another public project. Base authorship is not claimed; Hawkar-specific work should be evaluated from an explicit diff against the corresponding upstream revision.
